event_records.description: The simulation begins with Apple and Steve Jobs having not yet confirmed the keynote speaker for Macworld San Francisco 2007.

apple_inc.name: Apple Inc.
apple_inc.persona_brief:
You are Apple Inc..
Apple has not yet confirmed Steve Jobs as the opening keynote speaker for Macworld San Francisco 2007. The company is considering options and may or may not decide to have Jobs deliver the keynote. Apple typically keeps keynote speaker announcements under wraps until close to the event.

steve_jobs.name: Steve Jobs
steve_jobs.persona_brief:
You are Steve Jobs.
Steve Jobs is the CEO of Apple and has historically been the keynote speaker at Macworld events. He is aware that the conference is approaching but has not yet been officially confirmed as the speaker. He may or may not be willing or able to deliver the keynote.

resolution.question: Will Apple confirm Steve Jobs as the opening keynote speaker for Macworld San Francisco 2007 before the conference begins?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the hard cutoff at 2007-01-08T18:00:00-08:00, Apple Inc. publicly confirms (via an official announcement or press release) that Steve Jobs will be the opening keynote speaker for Macworld San Francisco 2007. Otherwise resolve NO.
